say:4:1711131003:0.text: That malice, intent on devouring everything, still lingers at the bottom of the untouchable abyss.
say:4:1711131003:0.source_cn: 那意图吞噬万物的恶意，依然盘踞在不可触及的深渊之底。

say:6:1711131005:1.text: It seems that this arduous and protracted struggle is far from over.
say:6:1711131005:1.source_cn: 看来这艰苦卓绝的抗争，还远远没有到谢幕的时候。

say:13:1711131012:1.text: You, with your mortal body, created a miracle that even the gods marvel at. Regarding this—
say:13:1711131012:1.source_cn: 你以凡人的血肉之躯，创造了连神明也为之侧目的奇迹。对此——

say:16:1711131015:1.text: If you are willing to grant me the privilege of continuing to accompany it, I will accept this eternal responsibility.
say:16:1711131015:1.source_cn: 如果您愿意赋予我继续陪伴它的特权，我将接下这份永恒的责任。

say:18:1711131017:1.text: I refuse to exercise this right, Goddess.
say:18:1711131017:1.source_cn: 我拒绝行使这项权利，女神。

say:21:1711131020:1.text: Therefore, I return this choice to you, to the immortal gods.
say:21:1711131020:1.source_cn: 所以，我将这个选择权交还给您，交还给不朽的神明。

say:23:1711131022:1.text: Roland, plunge your sword into this rock.
say:23:1711131022:1.source_cn: 罗兰，将你的剑，刺入这块磐石之中。

say:27:1711131025:1.text: When a baby is separated from its mother, the umbilical cord must be severed in order to gain independent life.
say:27:1711131025:1.source_cn: 婴儿脱离母体之时，必须斩断相连的脐带，方能获得独立的生命。

say:28:1711131026:1.text: And the gods were originally closely connected with the beings who created them.
say:28:1711131026:1.source_cn: 而神明，原本也与创造祂们的存在紧紧相连。

say:31:1711131029:1.text: What is the Tree of Life?

say:33:1711131031:1.text: When I decided to walk the path I had chosen, I severed it with my own hands, regardless of the cost.
say:33:1711131031:1.source_cn: 当我决心走上自己选择的道路时，我不顾一切代价，亲手斩断了它。

say:35:1711131033:1.text: The one who draws the sword is qualified to inherit the Radiant Empire.
say:35:1711131033:1.source_cn: 拔剑者，即拥有继承耀光帝国的资格。
